Configuration

Powerful.jl uses a multi-layer configuration system for customizing system parameters, model behavior, and solver options.

Quick Start

Configuration can be provided via TOML file or programmatically:

# From TOML file
config = load_config("simulation.toml")

# Or programmatically
config = SimConfig(
    system = SystemConfig(frequency_base = 50.0),
    solver = Dict{Symbol, Any}(:TDS => TDSConfig(convert_pq_to_zip = true))
)

# Pass to TDSProblem
prob = TDSProblem(sys, pf_sol, dyr_data; config = config, tspan = (0.0, 10.0))

Configuration Layers

The configuration system has three layers:

LayerPurposeExample
systemGlobal parametersFrequency base, MVA base
modelsPer-model-type settingsTGOV1 limits, deadbands
solverSolver-specific optionsTDS tolerances, ZIP conversion

TOML Format

[system]
frequency_base = 50.0    # Hz (default: 60.0)
mva_base = 100.0         # MVA (default: 100.0)

[models.TGOV1]
vmax_enabled = false     # Disable upper limit
vmin_enabled = true      # Keep lower limit
deadband = 0.001         # Speed deadband (pu)

[solver.TDS]
convert_pq_to_zip = true
p_zip = [0.3, 0.3, 0.4]  # 30% Z, 30% I, 40% P
q_zip = [0.3, 0.3, 0.4]
abstol = 1e-8

System Configuration

Global parameters affecting the entire simulation:

SystemConfig(
    frequency_base = 60.0,  # System frequency (Hz)
    mva_base = 100.0        # Power base (MVA)
)

Usage:

config = SimConfig(system = SystemConfig(frequency_base = 50.0))
freq = config.system.frequency_base  # Direct access

Model Settings

Per-model-type configuration accessed via the model type:

TGOV1Config

Turbine-governor model settings:

FieldTypeDefaultDescription
vmax_enabledBooltrueEnable upper valve limit
vmin_enabledBooltrueEnable lower valve limit
deadbandFloat640.0Speed deadband (pu)

Example:

# Disable limits for debugging
config = SimConfig(
    models = Dict{Symbol, Any}(:TGOV1 => TGOV1Config(
        vmax_enabled = false,
        vmin_enabled = false
    ))
)

Accessing Model Settings

Model settings are accessed type-stably via the model type parameter:

using Powerful.Models: TGOV1

settings = get_model_settings(config, TGOV1)
if settings.vmax_enabled
    # Apply upper limit
end

Solver Settings

TDSConfig

Time-domain simulation solver settings:

FieldTypeDefaultDescription
convert_pq_to_zipBoolfalseConvert PQ loads to ZIP model
p_zipNTuple{3,Float64}(0,0,1)Active power ZIP coefficients
q_zipNTuple{3,Float64}(0,0,1)Reactive power ZIP coefficients
flat_startBoolfalseUse flat start initialization
abstolFloat641e-6Absolute tolerance
reltolFloat641e-3Relative tolerance
maxiterInt10Maximum iterations

ZIP Model: The ZIP tuple (Z, I, P) specifies the fraction of load as:

  • Z (constant impedance): Power varies with V²
  • I (constant current): Power varies with V
  • P (constant power): Power independent of voltage

The tuple must sum to 1.0.

Example: 100% Constant Impedance Load

config = SimConfig(
    solver = Dict{Symbol, Any}(:TDS => TDSConfig(
        convert_pq_to_zip = true,
        p_zip = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0),  # 100% Z
        q_zip = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    ))
)

Accessing Solver Settings

settings = get_solver_settings(config, :TDS, TDSConfig)
if settings.convert_pq_to_zip
    # Apply ZIP conversion
end

Validation

The configuration system validates all settings:

Typo detection:

# TOML with typo
"""
[system]
frequenc_base = 50.0  # Typo!
"""
# Error: Unknown settings in [system]:
#   'frequenc_base' - did you mean 'frequency_base'?

ZIP validation:

TDSConfig(p_zip = (0.5, 0.5, 0.5))  # Sum > 1.0
# Error: p_zip must sum to 1.0, got 1.5

Complete Example

using Powerful, PowerFlowData, DifferentialEquations

# Load configuration
config = load_config("simulation.toml")

# Or build programmatically
config = SimConfig(
    system = SystemConfig(frequency_base = 50.0),
    models = Dict{Symbol, Any}(
        :TGOV1 => TGOV1Config(vmax_enabled = false)
    ),
    solver = Dict{Symbol, Any}(
        :TDS => TDSConfig(
            convert_pq_to_zip = true,
            p_zip = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            q_zip = (1.0, 0.0, 0.0)
        )
    )
)

# Use in simulation
case = PowerFlowData.parse_network("cases/ieee14.raw")
sys = SystemModel(case)
pf_sol = solve(ACPowerFlowProblem(sys), NewtonRaphson())
dyr_data = parse_dyr("cases/ieee14.dyr", sys)

prob = TDSProblem(sys, pf_sol, dyr_data;
    tspan = (0.0, 10.0),
    config = config
)
sol = solve(prob)

Adding Custom Model Settings

To add configuration to a new model:

  1. Define the settings struct with @kwdef:
@kwdef struct MyModelConfig
    param1::Bool = true
    param2::Float64 = 0.0
end
  1. Link to model via trait:
settings_type(::Type{<:MyModel}) = MyModelConfig
  1. Access in model code:
function calc_residuals!(ws, model::StructArray{M}, config, ...) where M
    settings = get_model_settings(config, M)
    if settings.param1
        # ...
    end
end

See Developer: Models for complete model implementation guide.
